A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.start_timestamp_nano}}) AS start_ns,
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_nano}}) AS end_ns,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint, any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name = 'loom.ci_telemetry.cycles'
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  pollers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT series.host AS host
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name = 'loom.ci_telemetry.cycles'
      AND s.unix_milli >= intDiv(start_ns, 1000000)
      AND s.unix_milli < intDiv(end_ns, 1000000)
  ),
  seen AS (
    SELECT if(resources_string['host.name'] != '', resources_string['host.name'], resources_string['host.id']) AS host,
           maxIf(toInt64(observed_timestamp), body = 'ci.run') AS last_run_ns,
           maxIf(toInt64(timestamp), attributes_string['loom.kind'] = 'host.export') AS last_export_ns
    FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
    WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_timestamp_nano}}
      AND timestamp < {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
    GROUP BY host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ns, 1000000000)) AS ts,
       p.host AS host,
       'arrival_silent' AS state,
       toFloat64(if(s.last_run_ns = 0, intDiv(end_ns - start_ns, 1000000000), intDiv(end_ns - s.last_run_ns, 1000000000)) - 21600) AS value
FROM pollers AS p
INNER JOIN seen AS s ON p.host = s.host
WHERE s.last_export_ns > 0
  AND intDiv(end_ns - s.last_export_ns, 1000000000) <= 1800
ORDER BY host

annotations.description: Poller host {{$labels.host}} has sent no ci.run log that SigNoz observed for {{$value}} s past the 6 h limit, while its host.export is healthy (a host.export log within 30 min). End-to-end check that CI telemetry arrives, whatever the internal cause (export backlog, failing poll, broken pipeline). Only hosts that emitted loom.ci_telemetry.cycles in the 12 h window are judged, so a host with no poller never fires, and a host whose host.export is also silent is left to host-export-silent. A poller host that sent no ci.run in the whole window reports the window length minus 6 h. Issues #12908, #12792.
